title: Make String Anti-palindrome
description: We call a string `s` of **even** length `n` an **anti-palindrome** if for each index `0 lexicographically smallest one. If it can't be made into an anti-palindrome, return *`"-1"`*.*
constraints: s consists only of lowercase English letters.
